about_the_game:
Puzzle with the master mogul in Dr. Bowow’s Eco-Extraction! Build Factories, Laboratories, and Mines to gather resources – never mind the environmental hazards. Keep it clean, keep it orderly, and above all, keep it profitable!

Join the Pack!

All the top dogs in business work for Dr. Bowow – and this could be your big break! Our Lead Researcher, Chief Waste Manager, and even the Dr. himself will guide you until you get all four feet under you. Em-bark on your next exciting corporate adventure!

Get That Cash!

Our bombastic Dr. Bowow has given you a stack of building plans and some seed funding, but it’s up to you to earn your keep. Use your plans to raise buildings. You’ll learn that each square plot of land has a value; a dense network of buildings will result in a bigger payout!

See the World (of Business)!

Dr. Bowow has tranquil properties all over the world, ripe for over-development! Your job will take you far and wide— from the frigid wastes of the arctic research station, to the lush forest we’re converting into lumber, not to mention the rich mineral deposits we’re mining on the plains! Each location presents a unique environment with its own challenges— can you conquer them all?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ventura (13)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7; Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5300M; M1 Integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dr. Bowow hasn't been extensively tested on Intel Mac models; an Apple Silicon Mac is strongly recommended.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Sequoia (15)
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 Pro Integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
